digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 21 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Rust, TypeScript, Python）和 15 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「其他热门」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: openai/codex
repos.description: Lightweight coding agent that runs in your terminal
repos.summary_zh: 终端里的轻量级编码代理，用 Rust 打造，让 AI 直接在命令行完成编程任务

repos.name: diegosouzapw/OmniRoute
repos.description: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 290+ providers (90+ free), 500+ models — Kimi, Claude, GPT, OpenAI, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniM
repos.summary_zh: 统一端点接入 290+ 模型供应商，90+ 免费模型零成本切换，兼容主流 AI 编码工具

repos.name: modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk
repos.description: The official Python SDK for Model Context Protocol servers and clients
repos.summary_zh: 官方 Python SDK 让模型上下文协议落地，统一打通 AI 与工具数据交互标准

repos.name: alibaba/open-code-review
repos.description: Fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comme
repos.summary_zh: 阿里自研代码审查利器，混合架构融合规则引擎与LLM，精准定位行级问题并内置多语言安全规则

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.name: BurntSushi/ripgrep
repos.description: ripgrep recursively searches directories for a regex pattern while respecting your gitignore
repos.summary_zh: 递归搜索文件秒级出结果，自动遵循 gitignore，Rust 写就的极速正则搜索神器

repos.name: appwrite/appwrite
repos.description: Appwrite® - complete cloud infrastructure for your web, mobile and AI apps. Including Auth, Databases, Storage, Functions, Messaging, Hosting, Realtim
repos.summary_zh: 开源后端云平台，集认证、数据库、存储、函数、实时消息于一体，让 Web 和 AI 应用开发免搭服务器

repos.name: vuejs/core
repos.description: 🖖 Vue.js is a progressive, incrementally-adoptable JavaScript framework for building UI on the web.
repos.summary_zh: 渐进式前端框架，虚拟DOM与响应式系统双驱动，让Web应用开发更灵活高效

repos.name: moeru-ai/airi
repos.description: 💖🧸 Self hosted, you-owned Grok Companion, a container of souls of waifu, cyber livings to bring them into our worlds, wishing to achieve Neuro-sama's
repos.summary_zh: 自托管 AI 伴侣容器，支持实时语音与 Minecraft 联动，把 waifu 灵魂带入现实世界

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.name: lyogavin/airllm
repos.description: AirLLM 70B inference with single 4GB GPU
repos.summary_zh: 单张4GB显卡跑70B大模型推理，把显存门槛直接打穿到消费级

repos.name: modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol
repos.description: Specification and documentation for the Model Context Protocol
repos.summary_zh: AI 与工具间标准化的上下文通信协议，让模型无缝调用外部数据与功能

repos.name: ai-dynamo/dynamo
repos.description: A Datacenter Scale Distributed Inference Serving Framework
repos.summary_zh: 数据中心级分布式推理框架，用Rust重写AI服务底座，主打超大规模集群下的低延迟高吞吐

repos.name: drumih/turbo-fieldfare
repos.description: Gemma 4 26B-A4B inference in ~2 GB of RAM on any M-series MacBook
repos.summary_zh: 苹果芯片 MacBook 仅需 2GB 内存即可本地运行 Gemma 4 26B-A4B，极低门槛部署大模型推理

categories.name: 🔬 模型训练与微调
categories.desc: 预训练、微调、对齐、评估等模型构建环节

repos.name: MoonshotAI/PerceptionBench
repos.description: PerceptionBench: Evaluating Atomic Visual Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
repos.summary_zh: 多模态大模型原子级视觉感知评测基准，专测细粒度视觉能力短板

categories.name: 🎨 应用与前端
categories.desc: 面向终端用户的 AI 应用、UI 组件、聊天界面

repos.name: rustdesk/rustdesk
repos.description: An open-source remote desktop application designed for self-hosting, as an alternative to TeamViewer.
repos.summary_zh: 开源远程桌面神器，自托管替代 TeamViewer，数据完全自主可控

repos.name: chatboxai/chatbox
repos.description: Powerful AI Client
repos.summary_zh: 跨平台 AI 客户端，聚合多模型统一对话，本地数据隐私安全，界面简洁如原生应用

repos.name: atuinsh/atuin
repos.description: ✨ Making your shell magical
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 重写 shell 历史记录，支持同步、搜索和 AI 补全，让命令行操作更高效智能

repos.name: cjpais/Handy
repos.description: A free, open source, and extensible speech-to-text application that works completely offline.
repos.summary_zh: 完全离线的免费开源语音转文字工具，用 Rust 打造，可扩展且隐私无忧

categories.name: 📦 其他热门
categories.desc: 值得关注的其他 AI/ML 开源项目

repos.name: astral-sh/uv
repos.description: An extremely fast Python package and project manager, written in Rust.
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 重写 Python 包管理与项目工具链，速度提升数十倍且兼容现有生态

repos.name: sherlock-project/sherlock
repos.description: Hunt down social media accounts by username across social networks
repos.summary_zh: 输入用户名即可跨平台追踪其社交账号，开源免费且支持超400个网站

repos.name: dani-garcia/vaultwarden
repos.description: Unofficial Bitwarden compatible server written in Rust, formerly known as bitwarden_rs
repos.summary_zh: 自托管密码管理首选，Rust 重写 Bitwarden 服务端，轻量高效且全功能兼容

repos.name: microsoft/AI-For-Beginners
repos.description: 12 Weeks, 24 Lessons, AI for All!
repos.summary_zh: 微软官方出品的 AI 入门教程，12 周 24 课覆盖从符号推理到生成式 AI 全栈知识，配代码实战与学习路径

papers.title: GradCuit: Credit-Assigned Gradient Flow Enables Robust and Interpretable Test-Time Latent Reasoning
papers.abstract: Optimization-based latent reasoning improves large language model outputs by optimizing instance-specific continuous states at test time while keeping model parameters frozen. Existing methods, howeve
papers.summary_zh: 提出梯度信用分配机制优化测试时潜在推理，无需解码令牌直连状态轨迹，在数学推理任务上准确率提升显著且具备可解释性

papers.title: A Simple Approximation to the Distribution of the Ridge Regression Estimator
papers.abstract: We present a simple Gaussian approximation to the finite-sample distribution of the classical ridge regression estimator. Our approximation captures the fact that, in finite samples, the ridge regress
papers.summary_zh: 提出岭回归估计量有限样本分布的简洁高斯近似，准确刻画其偏差方差权衡特性，无需复杂计算即可用于推断与预测误差评估

papers.title: The Condition-Number Barrier in Sparse Least Squares
papers.abstract: In [AS21], Axiotis and Sviridenko conjectured that the linear dependence on the restricted condition number in sparse convex optimization cannot be improved by a polynomial-time algorithm. We establis
papers.summary_zh: 证明稀疏最小二乘问题中条件数线性依赖无法被多项式时间算法突破，基于随机精确验证假设建立首个严格下界，填补稀疏凸优化理论空白

papers.title: UEmbed: Unified Sparse and Dense Multimodal Embeddings
papers.abstract: Sparse retrieval underpins modern search systems, from web search to retrieval-augmented generation. Existing work has introduced Learned Sparse Retrieval (LSR) to push beyond exact lexical matching t
papers.summary_zh: 提出统一稀疏与稠密多模态嵌入的UEmbed框架，突破编码器架构限制，实现生成式稀疏检索并显著提升语义匹配效率与检索精度

papers.title: Structured Memory for Edge Language Models: Persistent Context and Corpus Retrieval via O(1) SSM State Injection
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) imposes a prefill cost proportional to retrieved context length, and -- with Transformer backbones -- a KV-cache that grows with each generated token. State-Space
papers.summary_zh: 提出O(1)状态注入的持久上下文记忆方法，将RAG预填充成本降为零，同时消除KV缓存增长，实现边缘设备高效长文本检索与生成

papers.title: onepot-Bench 0: towards lab-aware in silico chemistry benchmarks
papers.abstract: Language models are playing an increasingly important role in laboratory science, performing tasks such as experiment planning, execution, and post-hoc analysis. However, precisely measuring their abi
papers.summary_zh: 提出实验室感知的化学基准onepot-Bench 0，融合任务规划与执行评估，填补现有基准对真实实验条件模拟的空白

papers.title: AtumAI: A Principled Framework for Agentic Generation of Datacenter Control-Plane Policies
papers.abstract: The efficiency of a datacenter rests on its control plane policies. Designing these policies is increasingly hard: the hardware-software stack grows fast, the design space is vast and interdependent,
papers.summary_zh: 提出AtumAI框架，以智能体生成数据中心控制面策略，自动化搜索设计空间，将单策略原型周期从数月压缩至数天

papers.title: A Taxonomy of Cognitive Capability Gaps in Generative and Agentic AI
papers.abstract: Cognitive AI seeks to move beyond language generation and autonomous task execution toward systems capable of sustained reasoning, adaptive behavior, persistent memory, and self-regulation. While gene
papers.summary_zh: 提出生成式与智能体AI认知能力差距分类体系，系统梳理推理、记忆、自适应等六大缺口，为评估和设计认知型AI提供结构化框架

papers.title: AURORA-LM: Autoencoding Unified Representation for Continuous-Latent Diffusion Language Modeling
papers.abstract: Language remains an outlier in generative modeling: while images, video, and audio are increasingly modeled in continuous latent spaces, text generation still relies predominantly on discrete tokens.
papers.summary_zh: 提出连续潜空间自编码语言建模框架，统一文本与多模态生成范式，在困惑度与采样效率上超越离散标记基线

papers.title: Pseudorandom Streams within Diffusion Models Act as Learnable Inputs That Affect Generation Quality
papers.abstract: Diffusion models rely on stochastic inputs, yet on finite-precision hardware, the "randomness" they consume is realized as deterministic numerical orbits generated by pseudorandom rules. Accessible or
papers.summary_zh: 揭示扩散模型伪随机流可作为可学习输入影响生成质量，创新性将随机性视为可训练参数，显著提升图像生成保真度与多样性

papers.title: Who Should Be Generated? Justifying Demographic Targets in Open-Ended Generation
papers.abstract: Fairness evaluation concerns not only what a model produces, but also what its outputs ought to be compared against. When a model generates "a CEO in the United States," the prompt leaves demographic
papers.summary_zh: 提出面向开放式生成的人口统计目标合理性判定框架，引入反事实基准与分布对齐度量，在性别与种族偏差测试中将公平性误差降低约四成

papers.title: MedPRESS: A Multi-turn Benchmark for Patient-Pressure-Induced Medical Sycophancy in LLMs
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for health-related advice. Existing research measures their safety with static questions rather than pressured patient-facing conversations. We intro
papers.summary_zh: 提出多轮医患压力对话基准MedPRESS，量化模型谄媚倾向，发现主流LLM在患者施压下错误率提升达42%，并验证压力类型与模型规模对迎合行为的影响

papers.title: Bridging Artificial Intelligence and Power Systems Education Using a Hands-On Executable Framework
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly central to power and energy systems, supporting modeling, forecasting, optimization, and control. Yet most existing works emphasize specialized application
papers.summary_zh: 提出基于可执行框架的电力系统AI教学法，以交互式实践弥合理论与应用鸿沟，降低跨学科学习门槛并提升知识迁移效率

papers.title: CoWAM: Coordination Contracts for Selective Policy Intervention with WAMs
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) augment robot policies with action-conditioned predicted futures, but a plausible future alone does not justify changing the action that a bimanual policy would execute. We
papers.summary_zh: 提出协调契约层选择性干预双臂机器人策略，以动作条件未来预测表达同步与角色兼容，显著提升协同任务成功率并降低冲突率

papers.title: Smooth Reparameterizations of Functions on Simplicial Product Spaces: Applications to Probabilistic Tensor Decomposition and Functional Data Registration
papers.abstract: We consider optimization problems defined on product spaces of simplices. Examples of this class of problems include learning low-rank discrete multivariate probability distributions via simplex const
papers.summary_zh: 提出单纯形积空间的光滑重参数化方法，统一处理概率张量分解与函数配准，显著提升优化收敛速度与数值稳定性
